title: How do I set up dependencies/visibility rules?
intent: This article explains how to configure visibility rules so that questions appear or hide based on respondent answers.
short_answer: Dependencies allow you to show or hide survey elements based on respondent answers. Configure them by selecting the target element, opening its properties, and defining which answers trigger its visibility. Use OR logic (any trigger shows the element) or AND logic (all triggers must be selected).
prerequisites: At least one choice-based question to serve as a trigger
Dependent element must be positioned after triggering elements
procedure: Open the survey in the editor
Select the element to make conditionally visible
Select trigger answers from other questions
important_conditions: Works with choice-based questions (single/multiple choice, matrix)
When triggering element is deleted, dependency is removed
Hidden elements have their answers NOT submitted
Progress bar is affected by dependencies
troubleshooting: Element not showing: Check dependency logic (OR/AND) and chained dependencies
Check visibility settings warning: Appears after editing answers that others depend on
Progress bar jumping: Expected with many dependencies
